requirementWeight: 0.45 divided equally among all request-derived explicit requirements
scores: Each criterion has separate integer A and B scores from 0 through 4
orderPolicy: Independent AB and BA aggregates, swapped game mapped to original candidate labels
tiePolicy: A tie or unknown score is wrong under the official benchmark metric
selectionInputs: DEV request shapes and the owner's decomposition instruction; no fit to suspect labels
scoringInputs: Request, its blind-derived criteria, complete candidate texts
